ownership: Official ADHS Provider and Facility Databases publication
allowed_use: bounded validation of the official monthly publication statement
HEAD-only validation of the two exact current reviewed childcare workbook URLs
immutable retention of privacy-safe metadata evidence
prohibited_use: workbook-body or provider-row acquisition in this version
using the stale GIS layer as a substitute
current-operation, completeness, ZIP-validity, or production claims
attribution: Arizona Department of Health Services, Public Health Licensing
retention: Catalog evidence and workbook response headers only; no workbook content.
redistribution: No provider records are acquired or redistributed.
temporal_limits: ADHS says tables are updated on the first business day monthly and represent the first day of the month, but also warns active facilities may be omitted during licensing-system migration.
review: A later version must inspect an explicitly authorized workbook, pin its run date and schema, exclude contacts, preserve ZIP5/ZIP4, conserve center and group-home rows separately, and retain the migration omission warning.
